FFmpeg in Townsquare
====================

The Townsquare Mac app includes two programs, ffmpeg and ffprobe (in
Contents/Resources/bin). Townsquare uses them to prepare photos, videos and voice
notes before they are posted. They are separate programs that Townsquare starts as
a child process; they are not linked into Townsquare itself.

What they are
-------------
FFmpeg 9.0.2, static builds for macOS (Apple silicon and Intel) made by Martin Riedl
(https://ffmpeg.martin-riedl.de, build script: https://git.martin-riedl.de/ffmpeg/build-script).
They are configured with --enable-gpl --enable-version3, so they are licensed under
the GNU General Public License version 3 (the full text is in COPYING.GPLv3 next to
this file). They include libx264 and libx265 (GPL) and many other libraries, each under
its own license (BSD, MIT, Apache 2.0, LGPL and others). Run
`ffmpeg -version` for the exact configuration, and see versions.txt next to this file
for the library versions in each build. The only things they load from the system are
Apple's own libraries and frameworks.

FFmpeg is a trademark of Fabrice Bellard, originator of the FFmpeg project.
FFmpeg is copyright (c) 2000-2026 the FFmpeg developers. https://ffmpeg.org

Townsquare itself is licensed under the GNU Affero General Public License v3 (the
LICENSE file in its source). It does not contain FFmpeg code.

Source code
-----------
The source code for FFmpeg 9.0.2 is at https://ffmpeg.org/releases/ffmpeg-9.0.2.tar.xz
(https://ffmpeg.org/download.html). The build script that produced these binaries,
with the exact versions and download links of every library, is at
https://git.martin-riedl.de/ffmpeg/build-script.

Written offer: for three years from the date you downloaded Townsquare, you can ask for
a copy of the complete corresponding source code of the ffmpeg and ffprobe programs
included here. Open an issue at https://github.com/nerveband/townsquare/issues and
we will send it.

You may replace these programs
------------------------------
Townsquare uses the ffmpeg and ffprobe in Contents/Resources/bin when they are
there. To use your own build instead, set TOWNSQUARE_FFMPEG_DIR to a folder that holds
`ffmpeg` and `ffprobe`, or replace the two files.

No warranty
-----------
FFmpeg is provided without any warranty, to the extent permitted by law. See
COPYING.GPLv3.
